rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: In the House of Councillors plenary on 30 October 2009, 山口那津男 says that on 8 September he was chosen as 公明党's representative ('私は、去る九月八日、公明党の代表に選任されました').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: In the same speech 山口那津男 speaks of what he has done since taking office as representative until that day ('代表に就任して以来今日まで').

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair (委員長) of 公明党 until its December 1994 division and of the representative (代表) of the 公明党 formed in November 1998, for CLAUDE-C01-31 only, 1990-2026. Convention and other party selections, recommendations, in-office attestations, resignation announcements, predecessor references, acting and interim arrangements (委員長代行 in 1994; the 代表代理 styled 代表 in 2026), other organizations' offices, the organizations' formation, division, merger, renaming and dissolution, and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (an organization event, another office, an acting or interim office). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial offices, parliamentary groups and other parties' offices are excluded: no row feeds them, and none of their claims feeds this office. Organization identities stay unresolved; no row maps or merges 公明党, 公明, 公明新党, 新進党, 新党平和, 黎明クラブ, 中道改革連合 or any other party.
